name: Upper Midwest critical infrastructure
description: Leak-site claims against energy, government and manufacturing victims, KEV entries for industrial-control vendors, and a watchlist of groups CISA has named for attacks on US critical infrastructure. These groups rarely post leak-site claims, so they are watched rather than alerted on. Alert rules have no place filter, so these rules fire for victims anywhere; the Upper Midwest page shows what Vigil holds about organizations in Minnesota, Wisconsin, Iowa, North Dakota and South Dakota.
